org.tmt.aps.peas.instrument.model

Class Instrument

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.tmt.aps.peas.instrument.model.Instrument

  • @Entity
public class Instrument
extends Object
    Entity class representing the Instrument class. Query defined on this class joins instrument with Ccd, Camera, referenceBeamSet, coarseTiltMirror, fineTiltMirror, pupilWheel, filterWheel, pupilMaskSet and filterMaskSet. This creates one data structure where all configuration can be accessed and state can be written/read to transient fields in each class.

    smichaels

      • updateState

        public void updateState(org.tmt.aps.peas.extinf.CameraStatus cameraStatus)
        Given a CameraStatus object, descends the reference chain to the PupilMask, Filter, Ref Beam, Shutter, fine and coarse tilt mirrors, two position mechanism, CCD power and temperatures and populates each of these with current states.
        Parameters:
        cameraStatus - the cameraStatus object to read from and apply. The source of the cameraStatus object is a status query to the PCS camera.

      • updateState

        public void updateState(CameraState cameraState)
        Given a CameraState object, descends the reference chain to the PupilMask, Filter, Ref Beam, Shutter, fine and coarse tilt mirrors, two position mechanism, CCD power and temperatures and populates each of these with current states.
        Parameters:
        cameraState - the cameraState object to read from and apply. The source of the cameraState object is a database query of the state of the camera.
